thread:
leo: Need final plan for the webinar + social launch cadence. Topic pick: "Making inference predictable: routing, cost controls, and rollout checks". Want a 60m session with a short benchmark demo + live Qs. Goals: trial signups + beta requests.
anika: Love it. Quick asks: 1) two speaker leads (tech + product) 2) 3 short abstracts for registration copy 3) rehearsal + publish schedule.
marco: I'll take product lead, frida can take tech demo? @frida?
frida: I can do the demo. Planning a 5-min baseline vs optimized run showing latency and token cost drop. Will need sample dataset and GLB test.
leo: Great. Abstract drafts (short):
- A: "Practical routing & caching for predictable inference" (ops + config)
- B: "Lower token costs without sacrificing output" (cost + quantization)
- C: "Safeguarding rollouts with evals & canaries" (quality + rollout)
marco: For registration copy, A+B combo is strongest. Use A headline, B hook in description.
anika: Social plan: announce 2 weeks out (teaser), 1 week (speaker reveal + benchmark snippet), 3 days (reminder + CTA), day of (1h before), follow-up (recording + CTAs). Use two creative variants: narrative-led vs data-led. A/B test on LinkedIn.
frida: Rehearsal windows? Ops-bot, can you provision webinar room + confirm test-stream 24h prior? Also we need a low-bandwidth fallback recording URL.
ops-bot: webinar-provisioner: room OK. Test stream required 24h prior. Can host pre-upload fallback recording to CDN; request a pre-signed URL.
leo: Run-of-show (60m):
- 00:00-05:00 intro + goals + house rules
- 05:00-20:00 keynote + product patterns (marco)
- 20:00-30:00 demo: before/after bench (frida)
- 30:00-50:00 moderated live Qs + breakout prompts
- 50:00-60:00 CTAs, trial link, next steps
anika: Lead gen wiring: HubSpot events: registered, attended_live, asked_question, clicked_cta. For A/B social, add `creative_variant` UTM param for tracking.
marco: Speaker assets: 1-slide speaker bio, 2 benchmark slides, 1-page cheat sheet for host. Deadline: assets by Tue EOD.
frida: I'll record a 3-min low-bandwidth fallback and upload by Tue EOD. Also will prep a local laptop script: `if stream drops -> share fallback link + continue Qs`.
leo: Okay actions: marco & frida to deliver assets Tue EOD, anika to draft social variants + registration copy by Wed, ops-bot to schedule rehearsal 48h before and enable recording. We'll meet quick Mon to finalize. :rocket:
